signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: No passwords here — we'll email you a one-time sign-in link.
signIn.sentBody: We've emailed a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.errorLinkInvalid: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a fresh one below.
signIn.errorUnavailable: Sign-in isn't available right now. Please try again shortly.
signIn.notConfigured: Honest answer: sign-in isn't connected yet in this environment, so no email was sent.
signIn.sendFailed: We couldn't send the sign-in link. Please check the address and try again.
